floorPlans.label: Emaar: Parkwood complete floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published one to three bedroom apartments in Towers A and B, together with the podium townhouse layouts. Where one sheet covers several unit groups, the area range includes all printed total areas. Match the unit reference on the complete sheet.
floorPlans.note: Published plans are not a statement of current inventory. Total area includes the listed balcony area and is not plot area. Layouts, dimensions, furnishings and indicated outlooks may change; confirm the selected unit and final sale plan.
